title: TLS service won't start: snakeoil certificate the ssl-cert package should have generated is missing
description_md:
This box was provisioned by cloning a golden VM image, and an internal TLS-terminating service refuses to start because it can't find `/etc/ssl/private/ssl-cert-snakeoil.key`. That's odd: `dpkg -s ssl-cert` says the package is fully installed and configured -- nothing looks unpacked or half-done. But the actual self-signed certificate the package's own setup step is supposed to generate on first boot was never produced on *this* host; the golden image carried dpkg's bookkeeping over, but not the host-specific artifact. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`) and get a valid, matching snakeoil key/cert pair in place the right way.

You're done when `/etc/ssl/private/ssl-cert-snakeoil.key` and `/etc/ssl/certs/ssl-cert-snakeoil.pem` exist as a valid, matching pair with the correct ownership.
